description: Turn a feature request or bug report into a verified, ordered implementation plan of small steps, each with files touched, a verification command, and a rollback point. Use when a task spans multiple files or steps, requirements are ambiguous, work will be handed to another agent or person, or before starting a refactor or migration. Covers scoping, open questions, risk ordering, and plan review. Not for one-line fixes, for high-level system design (see system-architecture-design), or for recording a single decision (see architecture-decision-records).
